an7.21:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Sārandade cetiye.
an7.21:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā Licchavī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te Licchavī Bhagavā etad avoca
an7.21:1.5: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an7.21:1.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te Licchavī Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.21:2.1: Katame ca Licchavī satta aparihāniyā dhammā
an7.21:2.2: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā,
an7.21:2.3: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:3.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā Vajjī karaṇīyāni karissanti,
an7.21:3.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:4.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī appaññattaṃ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathā paññatte porāṇe Vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti,
an7.21:4.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:5.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī, ye te Vajjīnaṃ Vajjimahallakā, te sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti,
an7.21:5.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:6.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī, yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okkassa pasayha vāsessanti,
an7.21:6.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:7.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjī, yāni tāni Vajjīnaṃ Vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni c' eva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ ca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti,
an7.21:7.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:8.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā bhavissati
an7.21:8.2: ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyun' ti,
an7.21:8.3: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
an7.21:9.1: Yāvakīvañ ca Licchavī ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā Vajjīsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu Vajjī sandississanti,
an7.21:9.2: vuddhi yeva Licchavī Vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī
